mandate: C428 — test the price-only PTLT: price-path peak/trough local time plus extreme recency asymmetry (occupation share at the running peak ptlt_max_occ, occupation share at the running trough ptlt_min_occ, peak/trough occupation imbalance ptlt_maxmin_imb, and extreme recency asymmetry ptlt_extreme_recency) stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W..t] (W+1 bars): running maximum M=max(C) and running minimum m=min(C); discretize C into B=32 equal-width bins between min(C) and max(C); peak local time L_peak=count of visits to the bin containing M; trough local time L_trough=count of visits to the bin containing m; ptlt_max_occ=L_peak/(W+1) (occupation share at peak); ptlt_min_occ=L_trough/(W+1) (occupation share at trough); ptlt_maxmin_imb=(L_peak-L_trough)/(L_peak+L_trough) (peak/trough occupation imbalance); ptlt_extreme_recency=(t-last_idx_at_max_bin)-(t-last_idx_at_min_bin) (recency asymmetry of the extremes). NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in C[t-W..t], degenerate window (min==max), or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (ptlt_max_occ_dev, ptlt_min_occ_dev, ptlt_maxmin_imb_dev, ptlt_extreme_recency_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W+1-bar close window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W..t] (W+1 bars); running maximum M=max(C) and running minimum m=min(C); discretize C into B=32 equal-width bins between min(C) and max(C); peak local time L_peak=count of visits to the bin containing M; trough local time L_trough=count of visits to the bin containing m; ptlt_max_occ=L_peak/(W+1) (occupation share at peak); ptlt_min_occ=L_trough/(W+1) (occupation share at trough); ptlt_maxmin_imb=(L_peak-L_trough)/(L_peak+L_trough) (peak/trough occupation imbalance); ptlt_extreme_recency=(t-last_idx_at_max_bin)-(t-last_idx_at_min_bin) (recency asymmetry of the extremes).
methodology.signals: ptlt_max_occ_dev/ptlt_min_occ_dev/ptlt_maxmin_imb_dev/ptlt_extreme_recency_dev plus phase-randomized-surrogate placebos over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.ptlt_vectorization_note: close matrix C=(T,10) built once; per asset, close series c[j]; per window ending at t, trailing W+1=257 closes c[t-W..t]; running maximum M=max(C) and running minimum m=min(C); discretize into B=32 equal-width bins; peak local time L_peak=count of visits to the bin containing M; trough local time L_trough=count of visits to the bin containing m; ptlt_max_occ/ptlt_min_occ/ptlt_maxmin_imb/ptlt_extreme_recency per window; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit peak/trough local-time binning + extreme-recency extraction, maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
